# Better Melted Sugar
**This is a small 'Better _x_' resource pack for [Create: Cafe](https://modrinth.com/create-cafe).**

---

Ever thought the **Melted Sugar Bucket** had an unrealistic color? Well, this resource pack fixes it!
## What This Adds
---
- Making the slightly brown, white-ish **Melted Sugar** completely brown, like IRL Caramel!
- Nothing else.
